where: Section 2: Distortion and noise, paragraph on shot noise
problem: The statement "Shot noise appears in semiconductor devices and is proportional to the square root of the current" is inaccurate. Shot‑noise current spectral density is proportional to the square root of the product of charge, average current and bandwidth (i² = 2qI·B). The noise power is proportional to the average current, not its square root.
fix: Replace the sentence with: "Shot noise appears in semiconductor devices. Its RMS current is i = √(2qI·B), so the noise power is proportional to the average current I."
